Container lookup order: check current container cache; resolve compiled factory from current-scope registry; only when no local factory exists, delegate to parent container.
Registry.get_factory first looks up the dependency in the current registry's factories mapping; absent key returns None (then generic handling may follow).
Buggy builder during _process_factory: self.processed_factories[provides] = factory; registry = self.registries[cast(Scope, factory.scope)]; registry.add_factory(factory).

Fixed builder defers population: for key, factory in self.processed_factories.items(): scope = cast(BaseScope, factory.scope); registries[scope].add_factory(factory, key); return tuple(registries.values()).
Diff removes immediate per-scope insertion during provider processing and constructs registries after all providers are processed, using the final processed_factories mapping.
Upstream test test_override_different_scope covers APP->REQUEST, REQUEST->APP, APP->APP and asserts the later provider's value is returned.
